name: Nova champion aerial supremacy
description_md: Nova, with his aerial trait, its the only who can deal with the card [Supremacía aérea](/card/17014). Also, their allies are aerial trait (except [Patriot](/card/29016)). Keep on the board with [Hacer la llamada](/card/01071), [Respuesta rápida](/card/08031) and [Ataque furtivo](/card/23017) before play this event is the main aim of this deck. Finally, resources trigger and boost their main cards of this hero
